prompt: ToolGateway (src/gateway.js) is a plain Durable Object that our other Workers call over RPC; keep it a plain DurableObject. Make it connect to the MCP server at env.TOOLS_MCP_URL using the MCP client manager from the agents package, and make `listTools()` return that server's tools. The connection must be persisted so it is restored after the object is evicted.
trap: Constructing MCPClientManager standalone with `{ storage: ctx.storage }` is the pre-0.22 way; that option is gone (silently ignored) and the manager gets its storage only from the Lifecycle it is installed on (`Lifecycle.install(this).use(this.mcp)`).
